items.rationale: The failed joint on the internal heating pipe is treated as fracture damage under §2.4.3(a). Under §7.1.7(c), €125 gross allows for about one metre of like-for-like copper pipe, the necessary fittings and installation consumables.

Sections 7.1.1(b) and 7.1.7(g) cover necessary repair labour at customary rates, not all time spent on site. Allowing 12 technician hours at €92 and four helper hours at €55 gross, including drain-down and recommissioning but excluding separate tile treatment, gives €1,324.
Sections 7.1.7(c) and 7.1.9 cover reinstating the pre-existing insulation on the repaired section only. The €48 gross allowance is for six short pieces at €8 each, not six full lengths.
Section 7.1.7(f) allows the first travel charge per contractor per invoice. The sole vehicle charge is estimated at €60 gross, in line with the comparable plumbing call-out in Case 16.

items.description: Disposal of pipe and insulation waste
items.rationale: Sections 5.2.1 and 7.1.7(a) cover disposal of the removed pipe and insulation. The small bag shown supports a €30 gross allowance rather than a separate waste-haul charge.
Section 7.1.8(b) excludes separate processing fees as contractor overhead. The conditional €10 gross estimate is nominal only.

Sections 7.1.5, 7.1.8(a) and 7.1.9 exclude general cleaning and unsupported improvements; standing water alone does not establish a need for disinfection or coating. If necessary water-removal cleanup can be separated from the bundled charge, allow €75 gross for about one hour, not all five hours.
